# Glitztype

> Retro WordArt in seconds. Glitztype draws a name or word in one of twelve WordArt styles and opens in the browser, with the whole piece carried inside the link (after ?s=), so nothing is uploaded and no account is needed.

Read SKILL.md and follow it to make WordArt for people as Glitztype links.

- [SKILL.md](https://glitztype.yolopreneur.lol/SKILL.md): the piece format and how to build its link
- [Editor](https://glitztype.yolopreneur.lol/): the page a Glitztype link opens in
